# ENDOMATICS — Autonomous Intelligence at Every Care Point

> ENDOMATICS is an AI-native, cloud-based Hospital Management System (HMS) and Medical Billing platform that unifies Outpatient Departments (OPD), Inpatient Departments (IPD), Emergency Room (ER) triage, pharmacy inventory, and Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) into a single self-correcting clinical operating layer.

## Certified Operational Metrics
- **0.00% Revenue Leakage**: Eliminates unbilled procedures, medications, and ward hours by binding bedside EHR logs directly to financial ledgers in real-time.
- **98.4% Billing Ledger Accuracy**: Achieved via autonomous charge capture and automated ICD-10/ICD-11 claims scrubbing.
- **-14 Minutes ER Wait Time**: Saved per critical emergency or pediatric case using dynamic predictive triage algorithms.
- **3.2x Faster Discharge Cycles**: Automated discharge clearances replace hours of retroactive multi-department billing audits.
- **4 Minutes Admission Latency**: Average admission-to-care workflow execution across inpatient wards.
- **<2 Seconds ICU Shift Handover**: Deep-learning synthesis converts telemetry and raw nursing notes into peer-reviewed handover documents.
- **99.9% Pharmacy Stock Assurance**: Real-time consumption burn rate models prevent shortages of critical medications (e.g., Ceftriaxone IV).
- **14 Days to Full Go-Live**: Structured 3-phase deployment with legacy database migration and zero active ward disruption.

## Core Modules & Capabilities
- [Core Features & Modules](https://endomatics.com/features): Real-time OPD queues, live IPD bed heatmaps, emergency triage, automated pharmacy reordering, and capacity forecasting.
- [Billing Intelligence & RCM](https://endomatics.com/#billing-intelligence): Real-time charge capture, multi-payer split ledgering, and autonomous claim scrubbing.
- [Onboarding & Implementation](https://endomatics.com/#process): 14-day zero-downtime deployment blueprint across physical wards, custom tariffs, and legacy data migration.
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://endomatics.com/#faq): Certified answers on clinical safety, compliance (HIPAA, SOC2 Type II, JCI), and architecture.
